in_sanskrit.name: अर्यवर्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is worthy, noble, or respectable. The name Aryavarta is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Arya' meaning noble and 'Varta' meaning one who turns or rules.

in_hindi.name: अर्यवर्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: Shresht, Pradhan. In Hindi, Aryavarta means noble, chief, or important.

in_tamil.name: அர்யவர்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ariyan, Aadchi. In Tamil, Aryavarta means nobleman, leader, or hero.

in_telugu.name: అర్యవర్ద
in_telugu.long_meaning: Arjadesha, Pradhan. In Telugu, Aryavarta means noble, ruler, or leader.

in_marathi.name: Aryavarta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The exalted land
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryavarta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aryavarta refers to the land of the noble or the exalted. It is mentioned in Hindu mythology and is considered the land of the virtuous and the learned. The name evokes a sense of pride and nobility.

in_bengali.name: Aryavarta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The exalted land
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aryavarta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Aryavarta refers to the land of the noble or the exalted. It is mentioned in Hindu mythology and is considered the land of the virtuous and the learned. The name evokes a sense of pride and nobility.
